content.comment_body: Hello, how can I password protect my [product_name] to prevent others from modifying its settings? Thanks.

Hi, there are several ways to secure your [product_name] against unauthorized access using passwords, including: protecting the program itself, preventing program copying, and restricting access to device menus. Please refer to the [document] and search for 'password' in the PDF for details. You are likely interested in password protection for menu access, which is covered around page 63 in the guide.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to secure their [product_name] devices by deploying password protection, mainly to block unauthorized configuration changes. Multiple password protection features are available, but documentation may be needed to understand these options thoroughly.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy way to enable password protection that prevents others from changing settings on the device.
